effects.text: A single subtle time reversal: a short backwards rush of air with a fast descending granular tape rewind texture, tiny reverse electric sparks drawing inward, ending in a precise soft click. One continuous gesture. Tactile and quiet, not a melody. No speech, no music.

Two small rigid glass panels slide quickly past each other and settle into place: a soft airy swish with a tiny dry tick as each lands. Close, clean, quiet software interface sound. No music, no voice, no reverb tail.

A small light object slips off an edge and falls away: a short soft descending whoosh fading into silence, with a faint glassy tick at the start. Quiet, dry, interface-like. No impact at the end, no music, no voice.

One understated warm electronic confirmation: a soft rounded glass plink with two closely spaced sympathetic harmonics and a subtle airy shimmer that resolves and fades quickly. Calm relief, precise software interface, no jingle, no music, no voice.
